title: 第二十四章收服成功第二十三章基德镇

第二十四章收服成功
陈林看着眼前被绑着几百人，说道“你们这些人，打家劫舍，无恶不作，本来都是该本处死的……”听陈林这么一说，这些人都开始求饶起来。
陈林看吓的差不多了，于是又接着说道“不过我现在给你们一个机会，如果愿意臣服我，不但以前的事既往不咎，而且还能给你们一份好差事！”
李大头没有任何犹豫，直接带头选择了臣服。因为他知道，自己这样六阶巅峰的实力，但是在这些贵族眼里根本不算什么，要是能够在贵族手里谋个好差事，可要比当土匪好多了。
看着纷纷投降的土匪，陈林并没有直接接受，而是让这些人一个个的进入帐篷，陈林一个个单独和他们见面，陈林正好用禁魂咒收服。
也许是死亡的威胁，也许是这些土匪真心的想要投降，陈林使用禁魂咒，竟然差不多都成功了。最后四百三十五人，成功了四百一十六人，剩下的十九人则是直接被处死。
这一次收服这些人，陈林得到了很多的信仰之力，不过因为陈林的身体还不够强大，灵魂也不能解开封印，这些信仰之力也用不上，陈林全部转化成纯净的魂力，提升这些人的天赋。
张叔和其它的一百多名护卫，对陈林相当的敬佩，原本都是桀骜不驯的土匪，被他一句话就都招降了，而且每个人都单聊了一会，现在每个投降的土匪都把陈林当做真神一样言听计从。
这其实都是禁魂咒的功劳，在被施展禁魂咒后，他们都成为陈林最终是的手下，不会有任何的私心完全都会为陈林着想，这就是禁魂咒的强大之处。
现在陈林多出了四百多名忠实的手下，而且如果*作的好的话，李大头还能替自己收服近两千多人的山贼。这可是一股不小的势力。
陈林秘密的和几个土匪的头领，谈了一段时间的话，就将这四百多人全部放了。谁了不知道陈林和他们说了什么，也不明白陈林为什么放他们，这些土匪再也没有在这里出现过。
陈林现在心情很好，自己原本没有‘用武之地’的禁魂咒，终于再次能够帮助自己，只不过必须要强行让对方放弃防抗。
“张叔，我们还有多长时间到基德城？”
“少爷，还需要两天，要是加紧赶路的话，明天晚上就能到达！少爷需要加紧赶路吗？”
“哦，这到不用！我们现在也不用那么着急，先去其它的两座城池看看。”
基德镇，领地虽然很大，但是只有三座城池，分别是基德城、凯瑟城、集镇城，三座城池以凯瑟城为定点，呈现一个三角形相互支援，驻守着神辉帝国的西北边境。
陈林现在距离集镇城最近，其它的两座城池距离相当，所以陈林要是先去其它两座城池，那么就会多出四五天的行程，不过陈林现在并不着急先去基德城，反倒是像先看看自己领地里这两座城池。
基德镇本就是陈家的领地，所以在这里的三座城池，都有陈家的人帮忙打理，在这些城池里做城主。集镇城也是一样，城主就是成家的人，集镇城原本只是个小集市，不过因为常年都会有很多奴隶会在这里交易，所以慢慢的，这里就成为了一座城池。
陈林作为成家的嫡系子孙，那怕是已经远离家族权利中心，但是在陈家的地位还是很高的，这是大家族的面子问题。所以那怕陈林已经‘失宠’，但是集镇城的城主，还是早早的出城迎接陈林。
陈林看着远处过来迎接自己的队伍，轻轻的一笑“看来自己的这个陈家大少的名头，还是有那么一点用处的。”

这时候一个身着华丽的胖子，走了过来，来人宽体胖个子又矮，看起来就像是一个圆球一样，上前说道“陈家，陈有财，拜见陈林少爷！”
陈有财只是陈家的一个分支成员，地位比陈林要低很多，所以对陈林很是恭敬。
陈林看着眼前的这个胖子，看起来很像是个只知道吃喝的饭桶，不过他能以陈家分支成员的身份，做上了城主，那么他必定有过人之处，陈林也没有摆架子。
平和的说道“陈城主太客气了，我以后还得要仰仗你，帮忙打理领地呢！”
“这都是属下分内的事！”陈林的语气，让这个陈有财受宠若惊。
不过陈林只是和他寒暄了几句后，就一同赶往集镇城。一路上陈林不断的和陈有财打听，关于集镇城的情况，毕竟以后这里可是自己的大本营。
集镇城是基德镇里最新建造的城池，只有不到五十年的历史，不过却是发展最快的，这里是基德镇最大的奴隶市场，全城有五十多万人，奴隶交易市场三个，每天在这里交易的奴隶数量不低于两万。
“这里的奴隶交易生意，大多都是帝国里的贵族家族的人在做，所以这里虽然没有什么达贵族，但也有很多小贵族爵位……”陈有财正在给陈林介绍，集镇城里的一些贵族。
陈林在路上发现，这个陈有财，虽然长相不怎么样，名字也不咋的，但是竟然也是一个法师，而且已经达到了五阶中级，虽然这个实力不算高，但是在这样的边境处的小城里，也算是一个小高手了。
很快陈林一行人就来到了集镇城，就在陈林要进城的时候，突然一辆装饰华丽的马车，急速的进入了集镇城，这两马车没有一丝避让，在陈林面前抢先进入，带起了一阵尘土。
看着那辆马车，这样的行为是很无礼的，陈林很是不爽“自己可是整个基德镇的领主，竟然在自己的领地里被被人抢道了，而且还敢无视本少爷。”
于是陈林皱眉问道“这是谁的马车？”
这个时候陈有财是紧皱眉头，说道“这是刘家的三少爷，现在打理刘家基德镇所有的生意，此人眼高于顶，仗着自己是刘家的少爷，平时很是骄横，不将旁人放在眼里……”
刘家，在神辉帝国也算是个一流的家族，刘家的家主是一为一等侯爵。不过跟陈家比起来，根本就不算什么。要是这个刘三少知道，陈林的真实身份，绝对不敢这么做。
陈林听陈有财这么说，也知道了对方的身份，冷笑道“哼，刘家三少，看来陈家的威信在边境，越来越低了，正好就拿这个刘三少开刀……”

Chapter 24 Successful Conquest
Chen Lin looked at the hundreds of people tied up in front of him and said, "You people, who robbed homes and houses and committed all kinds of evil, should have been put to death..." After hearing what Chen Lin said, these people began to beg for mercy.
Chen Lin was almost frightened, so he continued, "But I will give you a chance now. If you are willing to surrender to me, not only will the past things be forgotten, but you will also be given a good job!"
Li Datou did not hesitate and took the lead in choosing to surrender. Because he knew that his sixth-level peak strength was nothing in the eyes of these nobles. If he could find a good job with the nobles, it would be much better than being a bandit.
Seeing the bandits surrendering one after another, Chen Lin did not accept it directly. Instead, he asked these people to enter the tent one by one. Chen Lin met them one by one, and Chen Lin just used the soul-forbidden curse to subdue them.
Maybe it was the threat of death, or maybe the bandits really wanted to surrender, but Chen Lin almost succeeded in using the soul-forbidden spell. Of the last 435 people, 416 succeeded, and the remaining 19 were directly executed.
This time, Chen Lin gained a lot of power of faith by conquering these people. However, because Chen Lin's body was not strong enough and his soul could not break the seal, the power of faith was not used. Chen Lin converted all of it into pure soul power to enhance the talents of these people.
Uncle Zhang and more than a hundred other guards admired Chen Lin very much. They were all unruly bandits at first, but he surrendered them all with just one word, and everyone chatted for a while. Now every bandit who surrendered regarded Chen Lin as a true god and obeyed him.
This is actually all due to the Soul Forbidden Curse. After the Soul Forbidden Curse was cast, they all became Chen Lin's ultimate subordinates. They would not have any selfish motives and would only consider Chen Lin. This is the power of the Soul Forbidden Curse.
Now Chen Lin has more than 400 loyal subordinates, and if he works well, Li Datou can subdue nearly 2,000 bandits for him. This is quite a force.
Chen Lin secretly talked with several bandit leaders for a while and then released all the more than 400 people. Who knows what Chen Lin said to them, or why Chen Lin let them go. These bandits have never appeared here again.
Chen Lin is in a good mood now. The soul-forbidden spell that he had no use for before can finally help him again, but he must force the opponent to give up his resistance.
"Uncle Zhang, how long do we have to get to Kidd City?"
"Master, it will take two days. If we hurry up, we will arrive tomorrow night! Master, do you need to hurry up?"
"Oh, there's no need for that! We don't have to be in such a hurry now, let's go check out the other two cities first."
Although Kidd Town has a large territory, it only has three cities, namely Kidd City, Kaiser City, and Market Town. With Kaiser City as the fixed point, the three cities form a triangle to support each other and guard the northwest border of the Shenhui Empire.
Chen Lin is now the closest to Jizhen City, and the other two cities are about the same distance away. Therefore, if Chen Lin goes to the other two cities first, it will take an extra four or five days to travel. However, Chen Lin is not in a hurry to go to Kidd City first. Instead, he wants to take a look at these two cities in his own territory first.
Kidd Town is originally the territory of the Chen family, so people from the Chen family help manage the three cities here and serve as city lords in these cities. The same goes for Market Town City. The city owner is a married man. Market Town City was originally just a small market, but because many slaves would trade here all year round, it gradually became a city.
As a direct descendant of the Cheng family, Chen Lin still has a high status in the Chen family even though he is far away from the center of family power. This is a matter of face for the big family. So even if Chen Lin has alreadyFalling out of favor’, but the city lord of the market town still left the city early to greet Chen Lin.
Chen Lin looked at the team coming to greet him in the distance and smiled softly, "It seems that my title as the eldest son of the Chen family is still somewhat useful."
At this time, a fat man in gorgeous clothes walked over. The man was wide, fat and short. He looked like a round ball. He stepped forward and said, "Chen family, Chen Youcai, pay homage to Master Chen Lin!"
Chen Youcai is just a branch member of the Chen family, and his status is much lower than that of Chen Lin, so he is very respectful to Chen Lin.
Chen Lin looked at the fat man in front of him. He looked like a loser who only knew how to eat and drink. However, if he could become the city lord as a branch member of the Chen family, he must be something special. Chen Lin did not put on airs.
He said calmly, "City Master Chen is too polite. I will have to rely on you to help manage the territory in the future!"
"This is all the responsibility of subordinates!" Chen Lin's tone made Chen Youcai feel flattered.
However, Chen Lin only exchanged greetings with him and rushed to Jizhen City together. Along the way, Chen Lin kept asking Chen Youcai about the situation in Jizhen City. After all, this would be his base camp in the future.
Market Town is the newest city built in Kidd Town. It has a history of less than fifty years, but it is the fastest growing. It is the largest slave market in Kidd Town. There are more than 500,000 people in the city and there are three slave trading markets. The number of slaves traded here every day is no less than 20,000.
"Most of the slave trading business here is done by people from noble families in the empire, so although there are no high-ranking nobles here, there are also many minor noble titles..." Chen Youcai was introducing to Chen Lin some nobles in the market town.
Chen Lin discovered on the road that this Chen Youcai, although he didn't look very good and had a bad name, was actually a mage and had reached the fifth level of the intermediate level. Although his strength was not high, in a small town on the border, he was still a little master.
Soon Chen Lin and his party arrived at the market town. Just when Chen Lin was about to enter the city, suddenly a gorgeously decorated carriage entered the market town quickly. The two carriages entered the market first without any hesitation, in front of Chen Lin, bringing up a burst of dust.
Looking at the carriage, such behavior was very rude, and Chen Lin was very unhappy. "I am the lord of the entire Kidd Town, and yet I was robbed from my own territory, and I dared to ignore this young master."
So Chen Lin frowned and asked, "Whose carriage is this?"
At this time, Chen Youcai frowned and said, "This is the third young master of the Liu family. He is now in charge of all the Liu family's business in Kidd Town. This man has a high level of regard. Because he is the young master of the Liu family, he is usually very arrogant and does not take others seriously..."
The Liu family is considered a first-class family in the Shenhui Empire. The head of the Liu family is a first-class marquis. But compared to the Chen family, it was nothing. If Liu Sanshao knew Chen Lin's true identity, he would never dare to do this.
Chen Lin heard what Chen Youcai said and knew the identity of the other party. He sneered and said, "Huh, Third Young Master of the Liu family. It seems that the prestige of the Chen family is getting lower and lower at the border. It's just right to take action on this Third Young Master of the Liu family..."
